#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PORT={{local_port}}

if command -v cloudflared >/dev/null; then
  cloudflared tunnel --url "http://localhost:$PORT"
elif command -v ngrok >/dev/null; then
  ngrok http "$PORT" --subdomain {{subdomain}} --log stdout
else
  echo "install ngrok or cloudflared"; exit 1
fi
summary_zh: 本機 port 公開 tunnel 自動選工具
